# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Google, Naver, TikTok and commerce trend analysis
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Articles
- [AI가 우리 회사를 모르는 이유](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/why-ai-needs-company-data/): A beginner-friendly explanation of why business AI needs access to the right company data and how sales, product, customer and internal document data can support real workflows.
- [우리 회사에 AI, 어디부터 적용해야 할까?](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/where-to-start-ai-business/): A beginner guide to finding practical AI and automation opportunities in repetitive business work.
- [사내 엑셀·ERP 데이터를 API로 연결하는 방법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/excel-erp-api-integration/): How to connect Excel, ERP, CRM and commerce data through APIs and ETL pipelines.
- [Google·Naver·TikTok 트렌드 데이터를 한 대시보드로 묶는 방법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/market-trend-data-dashboard/): How to normalize and combine search, social trend and first-party business data into a dashboard.
- [경쟁사 가격·상품 데이터를 자동 수집해서 매출 기회 찾는 방법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/competitor-price-data-automation/): How to collect competitor price, stock, review and product data and connect alerts, dashboards and AI analysis.
- [내 비즈니스에 AI를 적용하고 매출 10배 올리기](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-business-10x-revenue/): A practical guide to connecting AI with customer acquisition, market research, marketing, sales and operations.
